_comment: What earlier toolkit versions installed and the current modules no longer do: GEM screen patterns (in /mnt/efs-system/engdefs) and script folders (under /mnt/efs-system/scripts). generate_uninstall.py keeps removing these forever, so a unit that ran an old card is still cleaned. Add an entry whenever a module is retired, merged or renamed; never delete one. Patterns were checked against the stock K0942_3 engdefs (183 files): none match an OEM screen.

retired.name: legacy GEM screens
retired.note: Patterns the hand-written uninstaller used before 2026-11-26 (module names of earlier versions).
